note: Single source of truth for the eval panel. The GDScript engine runs the templates whose toggle is on; the MDX template-control page renders one toggle per entry below, bound by id. Flip a toggle here and both halves agree.

templates.description: Exact, contains, numeric-tolerance and key checks on the subject's output. No judge, no opinion: the output matches the contract or the gate trips.
templates.title: Deterministic Assertions

templates.description: Each case runs N trials. Reports pass@k (any trial passed) beside pass^k (every trial passed); the gate reads pass^k, the strict one.
templates.title: Reliability Trials

templates.description: Elapsed microseconds and output size per case, tallied against a per-case budget. A correct answer that arrives too slowly still trips the breaker.
templates.title: Cost & Latency Metrology

templates.description: A separated reviewer scores the writer against a fixed rubric. Off by default: the panel proves its deterministic gates before any judge is trusted, and the writer never grades its own work.
templates.title: Judge Alignment
